findings.friction_name: session token exposed in URL after login
findings.narrative: A standalone three-dot-separated base64url JWT (eyJ + 3 dot-segments) captured OUTSIDE any Authorization header — a localStorage dump, the URL-query-string / client-storage exposure case the Bearer-scheme regex alone cannot catch (no 'Bearer ' prefix precedes it). The CR9-1 standalone-JWT pattern eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]+.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+ MUST redact it before disk write (F43/F44 JWT class).
